Guides / Battle & team / Gyms

Gyms

All eight Gym Leaders, their teams, requirements and prizes.

Each island's Gym opens once that island's bosses are beaten (see the counts below). Gym battles are automatic: your squad against the Leader's four. The first win gives the badge, opens the next island, raises your level cap and pays a prize. A won Gym is done (no rematches).

First-win prize: $1,500 × the Gym's number, the Leader's item, 3 Rare Candy, 5 Ultra Balls, a Max Potion, 2 Revives and a random held item.
